findings.note: An Oct 27, 2026 RotoWire/CBS update says Farabee scored a goal and an assist in Monday's 5-2 win over Toronto, which runs his point streak to five games, and gives him 11 points (six on the power play) in 11 games.

The Flames' recap of the Oct 22 win over Minnesota lists Farabee on the top line with Ben Jones and Matt Coronato, and says he leads Calgary forwards in shorthanded ice time, so he plays a lot in all situations.

This page notes Calgary's offensive struggles and shows Farabee had 38 points in 82 games last season, under a point per game. His game log includes a scoreless Oct 13 game, and preseason projections had him around 40 points.
